headword: {才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す
gloss: to bring out someone's talent; to draw out ability

definitions.gloss: to bring out someone's talent; to draw out ability
definitions.explanation: To help someone discover or develop their latent abilities.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To bring out a child's talent.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}せる→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧。
examples.english: A good teacher can bring out a student's talent.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧。
examples.english: That coach is good at bringing out the talent of young players.

notes:
A common expression combining ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧ (talent, ability) with ⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧ (to draw out, to pull out). The image is of talent being hidden inside a person and needing to be drawn out by a mentor, teacher, or environment. Frequently used in education and coaching contexts.

- ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧{才能|さいのう}を{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す: to draw out hidden talent
